sloka: समानयस्व सत्कृत्य सर्व देशेषु मानवान् ।मिथिलाधिपतिम् शूरम् जनकम् सत्य वादिनम् ॥१-१३-२१॥
transliteration: samānayasva satkṛtya sarva deśeṣu mānavān ।mithilādhipatim śūram janakam satya vādinam ॥1-13-21॥

translations.english: You may personally go and bring with due honour king Janaka who is the distinguished king of Mithila, a warrior whose truth is his strength proficient in all scriptures and the Vedas. Since he is an old ally, I am telling you in advance.
translations.hindi: इति द्वादशः सर्ग; || ब्राह्मणों के चले जाने पर, महाद्युतिमान्‌ महाराज ने मन्त्रियों को बिदा किया और स्वयं भी अन्तःपुर में चले गए
